task_description:
Add a new color theme to the application. This task creates a new theme entry in the COLOR_THEMES array, corresponding CSS variable blocks in globals.css, and adds the theme ID to the ColorTheme union type.

⚠️ EDIT THE COLORS BELOW BEFORE STARTING THIS TASK ⚠️
Replace every placeholder hex value with your desired color.
